scope: Request-local lossless model views of retained receipts for the same package B; no candidate change, final assessment, provider dispatch or budget increase.

authorReportedChecks.retainedException: One unmodified legacy catalogue-hash fixture mismatch was reported independently reproduced on HEAD; the fixture and acceptance rules were not changed.

findings.exactEffectView: Only verified, durable EvaConversationActionReceipt/v1 effects with dictionary expected and exact canonical expected/observed equality gain the local observed reference. Original observation and proof hashes remain bound to the complete retained receipt.
findings.requestBoundary: The index is created inside each helper invocation. Only earlier verified literal view values are indexed. Failed/ambiguous/unconfirmed outputs neither supply nor consume cross-receipt references. Duplicate call IDs disable cross-receipt compression.
findings.referenceTargets: References carry call ID, escaped JSON pointer, exact value SHA and original source receipt SHA. Digest matches also require exact encoded bytes. No forward or external-history target is introduced. Subtrees containing references are not indexed as targets.
findings.anchorsAndHashes: Existing local reference targets and their ancestors remain unchanged by cross-receipt compression. This preserves catalogue encoding hashes and prevents replacing local proof anchors with another cross-call reference.
findings.jsonTextEncoding: For the original equal effect proof only, json_string_fragments_v1 substitutes exact earlier literal strings using explicit json_escape_content_v1. Remaining text fragments preserve order and text; string SHA binds original UTF-8 text. The observed reference retains original proof/observation hashes and adds the actual expected-view hash/encoding.
findings.untrustedMetadata: String-pointer checks prevent invalid provider marker values from becoming anchors. Reserved reference/encoding dictionaries remain literal during fragment conversion. An original provider marker alone cannot activate effect encoding.
findings.originalEvidence: Complete durable receipts, action arguments, backend completion/readback validation, model roles/routes, retries and limits are unchanged. The view is model input only; no original receipt or candidate is rewritten.
findings.admissionAndSdk: The admission body and actual SDK message/deferred-tool history invoke the same deterministic history-view helper on the same receipts. This establishes representation parity; the offline fit remains an estimate under the existing admission rule.
findings.privacy: No external lookup, persisted cross-request index, new logging or public private-content output is added. Values already admitted into this request are referenced locally; privacy/authority selection remains in the existing backend.
findings.performanceLimit: Canonicalization, indexing and fragment matching scale with retained history and value sizes and can repeat work for nested values. The concrete eight-receipt envelope is covered; no general CPU, latency or provider-usage improvement is claimed.

resolvedReviewFindings: Local reference anchors could become cross-call references.
Catalogue view hashes could become stale after cross-receipt compression.
Non-string provider reference values could break anchor collection.
Provider-supplied effect markers could activate encoding without original equal-proof validation.

conclusion: GO for the exact corrected source and bounded deployment plan. The retained real continuation now fits the original admission cap without removing evidence, altering package B or changing criteria. Installed delivery and independent final quality remain separate.
